_doc: Services the build host's pull deployer (deployer.py) deploys from blinky_time master. A gated master commit that changes any of a service's paths (since the commit it runs) is deployed by running its deploy script from a checkout of that commit; a failed deploy rolls back to the commit before. required: check runs that must be green on the master commit (on top of every check being green and the PR's Claude review being clean).
